summary.text: Dale Hawkins represents Idaho House District 2, Seat B, and lives in Fernwood; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a second term and lists a small business owner and retiree occupation.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography says Hawkins has been a Fernwood resident for more than 24 years, served seven years as a reserve deputy with the Benewah County Sheriff's Office, and worked in mining, logging and construction.
The biography also says Hawkins is an NRA-certified firearms instructor.
